name: Graphite
description: Graphite queries program graphs built from JVM (Java, Kotlin, Android), JavaScript/TypeScript and Apple (Swift) code. Local stdio server: graphite mcp --graph <id>:<path>. Guard matches only the executable basename graphite. Every tool is a read-only query over graphs saved on local disk, and the server opens no socket. resource returns the content of a file packaged in the analyzed input, such as a config file, so it is reviewed. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Each tool maps to one GET route of the in-process Explorer API, except cypher, which POSTs a query to it. The stdio server dispatches to the router in-process and opens no socket.
Graphs are opened read-only. cypher refuses CREATE, MERGE, SET, DELETE and REMOVE with "graph is immutable", and its timeout is capped by the server (60 seconds by default).
resources lists only the paths and sources of files packaged in the analyzed input. resource returns one file's content, which can include credentials in config files such as application.yml.
Load only graphs built from code you may share with the agent. The server reads only what its command line names: the graph directory, each --graph, the *.graphite files in --data, and --topology.
For a shared HTTP setup, run graphite serve on loopback and keep the default /mcp Origin check; do not pass --mcp-allowed-origin '*'.
